description: This file defines an interface for system configuration services within the SalesManager core business system, providing a method to retrieve configuration data by key.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationService
classes.description: An interface extending a generic entity service, providing a contract for system configuration operations, including retrieving configurations by key.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a SystemConfiguration object corresponding to the provided key, potentially throwing a ServiceException if retrieval fails.
